# ZagScript 1.0 capability matrix

Generated by `bash tests/generate_zagscript_1_0_matrix.sh`; do not edit manually.

Linux x86-64 is the first authority. A 1.0 release requires every row to be `supported` by executable evidence.

| Area | Capability | Status | Evidence or blocker |
|---|---|---|---|
| frontend | shared Script profile parser and generated entry | `supported` | tests/run_script_frontend.sh |
| frontend | lossless indentation-aware CST with stable spans | `partial` | line/token spans, shared-lexer parity, INDENT/DEDENT events, bounded inconsistent/mixed-indentation and invalid-byte recovery records, layout-driven block closing, origin projection, and parser-boundary validation pass tests/run_script_cst.sh; header grammar and full recovery grammar remain in the Script normalizer |
| frontend | Python-shaped indentation convenience | `partial` | tests/run_script_python_shape.sh |
| frontend | Unicode and malformed-input recovery | `partial` | tests/run_zagscript_fuzz_smoke.sh |
| language | static types functions records enums generics and errors | `partial` | tests/run_typed_authority.sh |
| language | closures and bounded escape diagnostics | `partial` | tests/run_script_lifetime.sh |
| language | lists maps sets iterators ranges and Unicode strings | `partial` | tests/run_collections_unicode.sh proves typed maps/sets, generic iterators, bounded ranges, strict UTF-8 and native determinism; interpolation, Script-owned allocating collection cleanup, normalization, graphemes and broader Unicode text operations remain incomplete |
| language | async await and cancellation | `unavailable` | no ZagScript async/await surface or automatic cancellation propagation; the bounded cancellation token and channel adapters are library-only runtime slices |
| ir | one typed SSA IR is production authority | `partial` | tests/run_zir_authority.sh |
| ir | effects ownership aliases lifetimes layouts and origins in IR | `partial` | tests/run_zir_authority.sh |
| views | simple exact compact-source view | `supported` | tests/run_zagscript_views.sh |
| views | explained typed effect and policy view | `supported` | tests/run_zagscript_views.sh |
| views | explicit compilable strict-Zag expansion | `partial` | tests/run_script_cli.sh covers bound-AST materialization including compiler-bound prelude imports; default-edition process ownership, propagated try, and broader arbitrary Script equivalence still refuse expansion |
| views | native typed IR and instruction view | `partial` | tests/run_zagscript_views.sh and tests/run_zir_authority.sh expose whether the artifact consumed displayed ZIR; explicit contextual widths are complete in raw ZIR but still use the checked AST bridge, while untyped inference and broader artifact routes remain incomplete |
| reversal | portable exact unchanged unexpansion | `unavailable` | bounded v2 ledger codec has focused round-trip evidence; the foreground prepared-evidence adapter is source-integrated but runtime-disabled and not release-tested, so promote and unexpand refuse without publishing or consuming provenance |
| reversal | structural three-way edit projection | `partial` | tests/run_zagscript_views.sh covers one contiguous unique-context edit and localized conflicts; general supported edit sets remain incomplete |
| runtime | bounded allocator and deterministic shutdown | `supported` | tests/run_script_allocation_accounting.sh |
| runtime | files paths environment and processes | `supported` | tests/run_script_runtime_integration.sh |
| runtime | JSON and CSV | `partial` | tests/run_script_json_csv.sh proves general bounded codecs in strict Zag and Script parse/inspect; Script lifetime authority still rejects encode/free of imported owned aggregates |
| runtime | TCP UDP DNS TLS HTTP and WebSocket | `partial` | tests/run_network_foundation.sh, tests/run_http_websocket_foundation.sh, and tests/run_reference_tls_http_service.sh prove bounded IPv4 TCP/UDP/DNS, HTTP/1.1, RFC6455 and OpenSSL 3 loopback services; IPv6, system resolution, HTTP chunking/2/3, general async/cancellation and production security certification remain incomplete |
| runtime | async epoll worker pools channels and synchronization | `partial` | tests/run_linux_concurrency_services.sh, tests/run_cancel_token.sh, and tests/run_channel_cancel.sh prove bounded Linux epoll/eventfd, a single-producer single-consumer i64 channel, a join-only worker application, a one-shot release/acquire cooperative cancellation token, and bounded cancellation-aware channel waits; language async/await, automatic cancellation propagation, general worker pools, MPMC channels and scheduler integration remain unavailable |
| runtime | dynamic loading callbacks aggregates and database drivers | `partial` | tests/run_dynamic_abi.sh, tests/run_database_drivers.sh, tests/run_reference_dynamic_plugin.sh, and tests/run_reference_sqlite_http_service.sh prove bounded callbacks and aggregates, memory/SQLite KV drivers, dynamic-plugin lifecycle and an in-memory SQLite HTTP service; general ABI signatures persistence arbitrary SQL and plugin isolation remain incomplete |
| packages | deterministic lockfiles checksums offline vendor signatures and registry | `partial` | tests/run_package_resolution.sh passes 41/41 in an isolated ancestor-manifest-free workspace, proving resolver ownership, canonical local imports, manifest/lock provenance, path rejection, cache invalidation, relocation identity, semantic-fixture integration, and locked-vendor checks; tests/run_package_lock_generator.sh passes 4/4. Complete transitive and non-Zag asset locking, revision/version solving, package signatures, fetch/registry protocol, and symlink containment remain unavailable |
| daemon | stable snapshots invalidation singleton and foreground fallback | `supported` | tests/run_zagd_daemon.sh |
| daemon | typed semantic region extraction and equality saturation | `unavailable` | planner records are advisory and do not implement a semantic superoptimizer |
| optimization | proof certificates and foreground differential validation | `partial` | tests/run_zir_authority.sh passes 29/29 with a narrow source/policy-bound const-i32-add-v1 foreground opt-in, independent certificate mutation rejection, and raw-vs-AST/native differential witnesses; daemon automatic selection, measured workload differential validation, and general certificate domains remain unavailable |
| optimization | confidence-gated benchmark selection with no regressions | `partial` | tests/run_zagd_benchmark_policy.sh |
| generation | sandboxed optimizer generation promotion and rollback | `unavailable` | deep workers do not implement generational self-modification |
| deployment | static Linux x86-64 native executable authority | `partial` | tests/run_native_authority.sh remains the executable authority, but the dirty checkout is rejected by its pure-tree guard for ignored generated selfhost/native/znc.zag.c; isolated source-matched stage-18, stage-19, and stage-20 compilers were produced as static ELF64 x86-64 binaries, and stage-19 passed the source-matched reference suite, but the official clean-tree authority gate has not passed |
| deployment | clean bootstrap fixpoint and empty-PATH reproduction | `partial` | tests/check_native_bootstrap_repro.sh remains the executable authority; isolated source-matched stage-14 to stage-15 reached a byte-identical fixed point, and later stage-18 to stage-20 rebuilds completed with affected gates green, but the clean-tree bootstrap gate and empty-PATH reproduction remain blocked by the pure-tree guard and have not been release-certified |
| applications | required native reference application suite | `supported` | tests/run_zagscript_reference_apps.sh |
| release | zero partial or unavailable ZagScript 1.0 rows | `unavailable` | this matrix intentionally prevents a false 100 percent claim |
